description: This file contains a set of TypeConverter classes for a Room database in an Android application. It defines methods to convert custom data types such as DBStatus, CategorySortingMethod, and Calendar to and from primitive or supported types for database storage.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting custom enum types and Calendar objects to and from database-compatible formats.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a DBStatus enum, returning VOID if no match is found.

methods.name: dbStatusToString
methods.description: Converts a DBStatus enum to its string representation.

methods.name: categorySortingMethodFromString
methods.description: Converts an Integer to a CategorySortingMethod enum, using a default value if null.

methods.name: dbStatusToString (for CategorySortingMethod)
methods.description: Converts a CategorySortingMethod enum to its corresponding Integer ID.

methods.name: calendarFromLong
methods.description: Converts a Long timestamp to a Calendar object.

methods.name: calendarToLong
methods.description: Converts a Calendar object to its timestamp in milliseconds.
